name: 44902 · Mansfield, OH
findings: ZIP 44902 (Mansfield) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44902 (Mansfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44902 (Mansfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
